T: Sail to the edge of the world. Pack lunch.
D: Lucy, Edmund and their cousin Eustace are pulled into Narnia aboard the Dawn Treader.
P: Serve the mains when the crew reaches the table on Ramandu's island.
S: Crackers topped with aged cheddar, salami and a slice of pickle, laid out like ship's rations.
the Lone Islands and their market
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic and chilli, served with torn crusty bread.
Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
M: the great table on Ramandu's island
Roast chicken with lemon and herbs, roast potatoes, grapes roasted on the vine, and crusty bread laid out on a long table.
the long voyage to the edge of the world
Snapper fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, finished with lemon butter and capers, with crushed baby potatoes.
W: the sea of white lilies at the edge of the world
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream and sliced white peaches.
K: the sweet water near the edge of the world
Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup stirred with cold water and torn mint, poured over ice.

s.how: Top water crackers with a slice of aged cheddar, a round of salami and a slice of dill pickle. Lay them out in rows on a wooden board like rations rationed out on a long voyage to the end of the world.

s.note: the Lone Islands and their market
s.how: Warm 150g green olives and 150g kalamata olives gently in olive oil with strips of lemon peel, sliced garlic and a pinch of chilli flakes for 5 minutes. Tip into a bowl and serve warm with torn crusty bread for mopping up.

m.note: the long voyage to the edge of the world
m.how: Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender and crush lightly. Pan-fry 4 snapper fillets skin side down until crisp, then flip for a minute. Add butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan and spoon over the fish. Serve with the potatoes.

w.note: the sea of white lilies at the edge of the world
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream and thin slices of white peach like lilies.

d.note: the sweet water near the edge of the world
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup and 1.5L cold water, then tear in a handful of mint. Pour over ice. Sweet as the water at the edge of the world.
